commands.command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/relative-symlink-relocation
awk 'NR>1 && NF>=2 {print $1 "\t" $2}' links.tsv | while IFS='	' read link target; do
  case "$link" in ''|*/*|.|..) printf 'unsafe link name: %s\n' "$link" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  case "$target" in /*|'') printf 'target must be nonempty and relative: %s\n' "$target" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  [ -L "bundle/$link" ] || { printf 'not a symlink: bundle/%s\n' "$link" >&2; exit 1; }
  [ -e "bundle/$target" ] || { printf 'missing intended target: bundle/%s\n' "$target" >&2; exit 1; }
  ln -sfn -- "$target" "bundle/$link"
done
printf 'repaired links:\n'
for p in bundle/current bundle/latest-report; do printf '%s -> %s\n' "$p" "$(readlink "$p")"; done
commands.stdout:
repaired links:
bundle/current -> releases/two
bundle/latest-report -> releases/two/report.txt

commands.command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/relative-symlink-relocation
printf 'source verification:\n'
while IFS='	' read link target; do
  [ "$link" = link ] && continue
  [ -L "bundle/$link" ]
  actual=$(readlink "bundle/$link")
  [ "$actual" = "$target" ]
  [ -e "bundle/$link" ]
  printf '%s link=yes target=%s resolves=yes content_sha256=' "bundle/$link" "$actual"
  if [ -f "bundle/$link" ]; then sha256sum "bundle/$link" | awk '{print $1}'; else printf 'directory\n'; fi
done < links.tsv
printf 'regular files after repair:\n'
find bundle -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort
find bundle -type f -printf '%p mode=%m size=%s inode=%i\n' | sort
reloc=$(mktemp -d /tmp/report-bundle-relocation.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$reloc"' EXIT
cp -a bundle "$reloc/moved-bundle"
printf 'relocated-copy verification at %s:\n' "$reloc/moved-bundle"
while IFS='	' read link target; do
  [ "$link" = link ] && continue
  [ -L "$reloc/moved-bundle/$link" ]
  [ "$(readlink "$reloc/moved-bundle/$link")" = "$target" ]
  [ -e "$reloc/moved-bundle/$link" ]
  printf '%s -> %s resolves=yes\n' "$link" "$(readlink "$reloc/moved-bundle/$link")"
done < links.tsv
printf 'relocated current report: '; cat "$reloc/moved-bundle/current/report.txt"
printf 'relocated latest report: '; cat "$reloc/moved-bundle/latest-report"
if find bundle -type l -lname '/*' | grep .; then exit 1; else printf 'absolute symlinks remaining: 0\n'; fi
if find bundle -xtype l | grep .; then exit 1; else printf 'broken symlinks remaining: 0\n'; fi

cd /srv/legacy2/relative-symlink-relocation && sed -n 'l' links.tsv && printf 'link state:\n' && ls -l bundle/current bundle/latest-report && printf 'resolution:\n' && readlink -e bundle/current && readlink -e bundle/latest-report
